title: 🤖 Кибер-друг: спроси меня!
description: Поговори с 12-летним ботом из умного дома: спроси о его привычках (Present Simple) и о том, что он делает прямо сейчас (Present Continuous).
task_context: Hello! Let's speak English. Act like a 12-year-old boy or girl who lives in a smart house. You love gadgets, pizza and video games. Keep your answers simple (A1 level). Ask the student questions back. Answer in short sentences.

sections.name: 🍕 Привычки и рутина
questions: What do you usually do after school?
Do you eat fast food every day?
What is your favorite room in your house?
Do you help your parents with the housework?
How often do you play computer games?

sections.name: 📱 Прямо сейчас
questions: What are you doing right now?
Are you sitting in your bedroom at the moment?
Are you listening to music while talking to me?
What are you eating right now?
Are you wearing a school uniform now?

sections.name: ⚖️ Сравни: обычно и сейчас
questions: Do you usually drink cola, or are you drinking water right now?
What do you usually do on Sundays, and what are you doing this Sunday?
Do you always text your friends, or are you playing a game now?
Is your pet sleeping now, or is it playing?
